verdict.rationale: The IPO's own gov.uk pages say trade mark applications can be sent online. They also give an explicit 'File online' path for patents through One Login, and the IPO describes a suite of digital services to apply for, manage or renew patents. The core filing transaction can therefore be completed online per the service's own pages. Missing for 10: explicit statement that the fee (at least £205) is paid online as part of the filing, and hands-on or independent corroboration (the probe stopped at robots.txt on the application host).

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: You can send your application online or by post.
You'll need your One Login details if you have them, or you can set them up. File online
A suite of new digital services to apply for, manage or renew UK patents.
